about.title: From legacy code to learning machines
about.p1: I started out building a student portal for my college library, in PHP and Laravel, as an intern figuring out how production software actually gets made. Since then, I've spent four years migrating legacy systems — VB applications that businesses depended on but couldn't safely touch — into modern ASP.NET Core and Angular stacks, across three enterprise projects from architecture to deployment.
about.p2: Along the way I've designed RESTful APIs with Entity Framework, improved application performance by roughly 25% through better architecture and database handling, and worked in Agile teams that consistently hit on-time delivery.
about.p3: I'm currently based in Berlin, pursuing an M.Sc. in Artificial Intelligence, focused on machine learning, NLP, computer vision, and robotics. My goal isn't to leave software engineering behind — it's to bring the same rigor I've applied to legacy systems to building dependable, intelligent products.
